records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 29, 2024, 35% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Twelve-month backlog increased in the third quarter of 2024 compared with the third quarter of 2023, driven by long-term orders that moved into twelve-month backlog across both space and defense programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Partially offsetting these increases was a decline in Industrial's twelve-month backlog due to lower orders in our industrial automation market.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the third quarter of 2023, driven by improved performance on our space vehicle development programs in Space and Defense and a favorable sales mix in Commercial Aircraft.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased in the third quarter and in the first three quarters of 2024 compared to the same periods of 2023, driven by product demand in Military Aircraft and Space and Defense, and by production ramps in Commercial Aircraft.
